hooks.command: echo '$ARGUMENTS' | jq -r '.file_path // empty' | while read -r file; do if [[ $file == *.rb ]]; then echo "🔍 Checking $file..."; ruby -c "$file" 2>&1 | grep -v 'Syntax OK' || true; bin/rubocop --autocorrect-all "$file" 2>&1 | tail -5 || true; fi; done
